title: Bram and the Witness
author: Isandro Voss
blurb: Ada Eastwick, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
